description: This file is a shell script that sets up and runs a series of tests for git's atomic push feature, including scenarios with different refspecs, hooks, configurations, and failure modes.

methods.name: mk_repo_pair
methods.description: Creates a pair of repositories 'upstream' and 'workbench', sets up remote tracking, and configures server-side hooks.

methods.name: test_refs
methods.description: Verifies that specific refs in upstream and workbench repositories are in sync by comparing their rev-parse outputs.

methods.name: fmt_status_report
methods.description: Formats the output of push status messages to show simplified progress and errors.
